objective: Diagnose pre-push accepted-wrapper byte mismatch after local main checkout
expectedBehavior: Accepted artifact bytes and sealed native evidence remain unchanged before ordinary push

stableFailureTuple.phase: after git checkout/ff merge before push

episodes.changeSummary: Native research and scope/acceptance passed; checkout converted new .cmd LF to CRLF

constraints: Do not rerun native or core tests for newline-only wrapper restoration
Do not change Git global config

candidateHypotheses.statement: core.autocrlf true converted the newly introduced .cmd during checkout/ff merge

causeAnalysis.symptom: One accepted wrapper raw hash differs before push
causeAnalysis.mechanism: Git leaves indexed LF source intact and writes CRLF working-tree text on checkout
causeAnalysis.rootCondition: New .cmd uses inherited text=auto with core.autocrlf true and no per-file fixed eol

discriminatingEvidence.statement: Exactly 34 LF line terminators became CRLF; removing CR returns exact sealed bytes and expected SHA

eliminationObservation.statement: Git indexed source equals sealed LF source; all other accepted target hashes matched; native data and report definitions unchanged
